reason: The GL Code comboboxes carry autocomplete="garbage" next to data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore, a deliberate switch-off of browser and password-manager autofill. GL Code is an accounting category, not information about the user and not one of the 1.3.5 input purposes, so no A or AA criterion fails on either sampled state.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose covers only fields that collect information about the user and serve one of the listed input purposes (name, email, address, card number and so on). GL Code is a bookkeeping category with no matching token, so the invalid value does not fail 1.3.5. 4.1.2: both probes show role combobox, name GL Code, expanded and haspopup states exposed. 1.3.1 and 3.3.2: the visible GL Code label and the accessible name match on both states. No other A or AA criterion concerns the autocomplete value.
